newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares rise on Den Danske, Tele Danmark.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares rise on Den Danske, Tele Danmark.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Wednesday, powered largely by Den Danske Bank and Tele Danmark and dealers saw prospects of further gains on Thursday if buyers' liquidity held out.
"(The market) will probably rise again tomorrow, although the question is whether buyers have emptied their purses today," a dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index gained 1.15 point to close at 143.90, in overall bourse turnover of 1.56 billion crowns. The KFX March future rose 0.90 point to 144.40, with 190 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

Traders said that foreign buyers pushed Den Danske Bank up 10 crowns to 497 but they were unaware of any specific reason for the interest, which failed to spread to rival Unidanmark, left unchanged at 340 crowns.
"It may well be that they might take a look at Unidanmark tomorrow," the dealer said.
Tele Danmark rose 13 crowns to a record high of 350, after Goldman Sachs put the share on its recommended list.
Den Danske Bank's recommendation of ISS, however, failed to help the cleaning group, which fell two crowns to 161. Ole Mikkelsen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
